rappel_detail.anchor: fixed slings (in-situ webbing); inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The notch and crack area just below the true summit, above the 15-ft crux crack.
rappel_detail.notes: Optional: most parties downclimb the crux crack and the exposed Class 4 ledge instead. The rappel goes off the east side back to the ledge on the north side; even with a 60 m rope, expect to downclimb some Class 3 terrain after it.

set.descent: Reverse the ascent: downclimb (or make one optional rappel off the summit slings), cross back through the right-most notch, and descend the talus and scree to the cirque.
